name: 32327 · Crawfordville, FL
findings: ZIP 32327 (Crawfordville) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32327 (Crawfordville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32327 (Crawfordville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).
